mobile_first_rules: Designed primarily for mobile screen widths (320px, 360px, 390px, 412px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px).
Touch targets strictly >= 44px height (all buttons, select items, tab triggers).
Forms stack to single column on mobile, with auto-formatted inputs (CPF: 000.000.000-00, Phone: (00) 00000-0000, CEP: 00000-000).
Tables convert into structured mobile cards on viewports < 768px with full label-value clarity.
Zero horizontal scrolling on any viewport width; full fluid responsive grid containers.
Bottom padding `pb-24` on mobile views to ensure floating WhatsApp button never obscures interactive forms or checkout buttons.

motion_and_interactions.engine: tw-animate-css + Tailwind transitions + Motion for React
rules: Hover transitions: use specific properties `transition-colors duration-200`, `transition-transform duration-200` (never universal transition: all).
Group Card hover: subtle lift `-translate-y-1` and mint border highlight `border-[#00E676]/60 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,230,118,0.15)]`.
CTA Button press: `active:scale-[0.98]` tactile click response.
Accordion / FAQ toggle: smooth expand/collapse transition.
Chart Tooltips: custom dark backdrop with emerald border and mint data readout.

accessibility_and_testing.test_id_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, tabs, group cards, action buttons) MUST have kebab-case `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='cta-hero-investir', data-testid='group-card-gr50', data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='admin-approve-withdrawal-btn').
accessibility_and_testing.form_accessibility: All inputs mapped with explicit label element and `id`. Brazilian mask inputs for CPF, CEP, and Phone should maintain clean unmasked raw values in state.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_check: Every text color token maintains WCAG AA (4.5:1+) ratio on dark graphite `#1C1E21`, deep graphite `#141618`, and emerald `#004D40` backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Apply Dark Graphite `#1C1E21` as the base canvas, Deep Emerald `#004D40` for secondary brand containers, and Mint `#00E676` for high-impact CTAs and yield accents.
2. Use the official provided FAST INVESTIMENTOS logo url in both Landing Nav, Auth Screens, and Dashboard headers.
3. Build all 10 investment groups (GR 50 to GR 1.000) with both modalities (15 business days @ 15% and 30 business days @ 35%).
4. Ensure date and yield calculations follow Brazilian business days (dias úteis) with timezone `America/Sao_Paulo`.

5. Ensure the floating WhatsApp button is present across all pages, configurable from admin settings, and positioned with proper z-index and bottom safe margins so it doesn't collide with mobile actions.
6. Build a complete, responsive Admin Panel with withdrawal approvals (including justification note) and settings management for payment link and WhatsApp number.
7. Include complete test IDs across all clickable and informational items for automated verification.
